<notes>
All 9 rollouts (3 base + 6 candidates) delivered the correct answer "**Saturday**" with perfect consistency. No divergence, no failures, no repeated errors, no risk visible in any trajectory. All candidates show "(no change)" — they are identical to the base harness. All three earlier aggregators (inv1, inv2, inv3 decisions; dom1, dom2, dom3 decisions) concluded KEEP_BASE for this exact reason: the task is already solved correctly and cheaply by the current harness in a single LLM call. The mathematics (521 mod 7 = 3 days forward from Wednesday) is sound in all runs. No trajectory moment shows a deficiency that editing would address. Token usage is efficient (~1600–2500 per run), all runs completed in 1 step, and the extraction logic (last non-empty line) reliably captures the weekday name. Adding prose, helper code, or additional model calls would only increase cost without addressing any failure or ambiguity in the evidence.
</notes>

KEEP_BASE
